title: Wire IDs
description: The IDs that cross the wire as closed types, and AgentRef (#15397, docs/plans/plan-typed-core.md 2.3). New wire schemas use x-id for the same names; the contract MachineID/SessionID/InteractionID are distinct from core's opaque agentref types, and an adapter converts between them once.

MachineID.description: A computer that runs a node, as the hub names it.

SessionID.description: An Agent session, as its machine names it. Opaque: never parsed.

InteractionID.description: One pending question, plan or tool approval of a session.

HubID.description: A hub, as a device pairs with it.

DeviceID.description: A paired device: a phone, watch, Mac, web browser.

ClientMsgID.description: A message id a client makes so a resend is not delivered twice.

AgentRef.description: The one shape for "points at an Agent": the machine it runs on and its session there. Replaces [2]string and paired string parameters.
